instagram:
Website pe call button nahi dikhta? Customer number dhundhte hue chala jata hai.

Customer ne services padhin, prices dekhe, sab pasand aaya. Phir call karna chaha, par number kahin nahi mila. Usne tab band kar diya. Yeh website ki sabse aam galti hai: koi saaf next step nahi.

Is reel mein:
✅ Next step yaani woh button jo bataye ab kya karna hai
✅ Hero section mein bada button, jis par wahi likha ho jo hoga
✅ Mobile par sticky bar jisme Call aur WhatsApp dono hon

Test: apne phone par apni website kholiye aur timer lagaiye. Call ya WhatsApp karne mein kitne seconds lage?

Aapki website par call button dhundhne mein kitne seconds lagte hain? Comment mein bataiye 👇
